summary:
Phase 3 complete — all 14 apps built, wired, and verified. Prior C-grade recommendations addressed.

14 apps across 4 steps:
1. Essential (6): Finder, Safari, Notes, Calculator, Terminal, System Settings.
2. Productivity (4): Mail, Calendar, Messages, TextEdit.
3. Media/utility (4): Music, Photos, Maps, Clock.
4. Verification: 18 runtime tests.

Grader recommendations addressed:
1. FIXED inverted Reduce Transparency toggle (SystemSettingsApp.tsx:59 `theme.setReduceTransparency(!v)` → `theme.setReduceTransparency(v)`). Now test-covered: system-settings.test.tsx asserts toggling ON adds `reduce-transparency` class to <html>.
2. ADDED System Settings theme test coverage (4 tests in src/test/system-settings.test.tsx): Dark Mode flips data-theme, Reduce Transparency adds class (not inverted), Accent Color sets data-accent, Wallpaper sets --desktop-gradient CSS var. Added `data-testid` + `aria-label` to ToggleRow for robust querying.
3. REMOVED dead code src/apps/FinderStub.tsx (superseded by FinderApp); no remaining references; build clean.

Total test coverage: 18 tests across 4 files (5 overlay open+render, 8 app interactive behavior, 4 system-settings theme write-through, 1 focus→menu-bar). All passing.

Verification: pnpm build exit 0 (462 modules, 426.69 kB JS), pnpm exec oxlint 0/0 (64 files), pnpm exec vitest 18/18.

All wired into App.tsx renderApp switch (14 cases). Build clean, type-safe, fully tested.
